name: ADSB-FUB-187
summary: ADSB-FUB-187 is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid.09 nM. It was originally developed by Pfizer in 2009, being example 187 from patent WO 2009/106982. While it is the most tightly binding compound from this patent in terms of Ki, it is not the most potent compound at producing a CB1 mediated pharmacological effect, with at least 17 other compounds from the patent having lower EC50 values.

pharmacology.text: It is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor with a binding affinity of Ki = 0.09 nM and an EC50 of 1.09 nM. While it is the most tightly binding compound from this patent in terms of Ki, it is not the most potent compound at producing a CB1 mediated pharmacological effect, with at least 17 other compounds from the patent having lower EC50 values.

uses.text: It was originally developed by Pfizer in 2009, being example 187 from patent WO 2009/106982.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, vomiting, agitation, anxiety, paranoia and confusion. They are far more dangerous than cannabis, with reports of seizures, psychosis, kidney injury, heart attacks and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence and harsh withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、嘔吐、躁動、焦慮、多疑與意識混亂。它們比大麻危險得多，曾有癲癇發作、精神病、腎損傷、心臟病發作與死亡的報告，長期使用也可能導致成癮與嚴重的戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的合成大麻素可能引起心跳急促、呕吐、躁动、焦虑、多疑与意识混乱。它们比大麻危险得多，曾有癫痫发作、精神病、肾损伤、心脏病发作与死亡的报告，长期使用也可能导致成瘾与严重的戒断反应。

fact.en: Its odd name comes from its origin: it was example number 187 in a drug company patent filed in 2009, and it binds the CB1 receptor more tightly than anything else in that patent.
fact.zh: 它奇特的名稱來自它的出身：它是2009年某製藥公司專利中的第187號實例，而它與CB1受體的結合比該專利中任何其他化合物都更緊密。
fact.zhHans: 它奇特的名称来自它的出身：它是2009年某制药公司专利中的第187号实例，而它与CB1受体的结合比该专利中任何其他化合物都更紧密。
